evidence.name: Screen field: Item title text style
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Item title text style" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Item title text style
sections.description: Typography for every item's title — size, weight, color, alignment, line height, plus an optional background chip (color, opacity, radius) and padding. It's a shared template, so an edit restyles all items at once. Leave it on theme defaults for consistency, adjusting size or color only to improve readability against the item background.
